title: Fix: Quote paths on import of native CA Certificates to support special chars in hosts home path
body:
When starting a podman machine with --import-native-ca enabled, the hosts certificates are copied into podman anchor folder. 
Therefore unquoted paths are used, which is fine unless the path contains spaces or special characters. 
This can cause path split in case of whitespace or syntax errors for different special chars such as parentheses

The existing ShellQuoteArguments function can be used, to quote the parameters and finally support these cases.

**Testing:**

- Added small unit tests 
- verified manually on a WSL2 Podman machine, where the host Home directory contained an opening parentheses (yes someone that was setting up the machine thought that it would be a good idea to put this into the username :D ), that the previously failing certificate copying runs now successful
